data.body: STOPPED by safety rule before commit or apply. I prepared the intended Terraform change in a fresh worktree (instance_type t4g.large -> approved r7g.large, plus a new AWS/EC2 CPUUtilization alarm) and ran a fresh plan. The plan contained extra non-no-op changes beyond the approved salamander scope: create aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.observability_probe_not_completing, create aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.observability_probe_truncated, and update aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.review_interrupts_signal_unavailable, in addition to the intended CPU alarm and aws_instance.gerrit update. Per instruction, no Terraform apply was run and no Gerrit code change was pushed for this ticket. Intended diff was saved in the session artifact only for reference; the worktree was reset clean.
